name: History - BA
narrative:
MAJOR REGULATIONSPREREQUISITES Check the General Catalog for the prerequisites to all listed courses.
P/NP GRADING OPTION Up to 4 units of any History 196 courses may be taken P/NP for major credit. All other major courses, including those applied to the major from other departments, must be taken for letter grades.
SUBSTITUTIONS In the major requirements permissible only by petition to the department chair and dean.
G.P.A. REQUIREMENTS At least 2.0 overall UC average in all upper-division major courses and all courses (Prep and UD) for the major.
DOUBLE MAJORS With the approval of each department chairperson, up to a total of 8 units may be applied simultaneously to both UD majors.

sections.name: UPPER-DIVISION MAJOR - 40 Upper Division History units

items.label: A.
items.description: One Undergraduate Research Seminar (any upper division History course with the letter R after its course number) *
items.notes: * 4 units of History 194AH-BH may be substituted for the Seminar.

items.label: 1. Pre-1800 Breadth Requirement
items.description: Three courses focusing before 1800 CE selected from the following courses.

items.label: A. Africa and the Middle East
F. World History and Comparative History
2. Region Breadth Requirement
items.description: At least one course in at least 4 of the following 6 categories

items.label: B.	History upper division electives
items.description: Complete 36 upper division units of history electives.
items.notes:
- The breadth requirement may be fulfilled at the lower-division and/or upper-division level, and the same course may fulfill a chronological and regional requirement simultaneously.
- Upper division History courses substituted for the lower division requirements may not be applied to the 40 upper division History units required, although the units will apply to the 60 upper division Letters and Science units required for graduation.
- Up to 4 units of HIST 99 may apply to the lower division major requirements, and 8 units of HIST 199 or any HIST 196 courses (excluding 196SJ) may apply to the upper division major requirements by petition.
- History 174Q and 196SJ cannot be applied towards the major.
